The '''Saber Guard''' was an [[Special forces/Legends|elite]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security force]] deployed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to protect [[Timira City Cloning Facility|top secret]] [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facilities on [[Timira City]]. Established under the [[Saber Program]], they had [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] training and a degree of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force potential]]. 

==Background==
The Saber Guards were assigned on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] in the [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] [[Timira City Cloning Facility|facility]] in [[Timira City]] in order to protect the complex. They were known to have some degree of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force potential]] such as [[Force resistance]] and can [[Telekinesis/Legends#Saber Throw|throw lightsabers]], though their main area of expertise was in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]], in which they utilized two [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] that emitted red-colored blades. In combat, the Saber Guards were frequently paired with the [[Imperial Sith Acolyte]]s in the [[Acolyte Program]]. Given their prowess in lightsaber combat and rarity seen with the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], Saber Guards were among the most fearsome warriors of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TFU2vg" />

==History==
Saber Guards were deployed during the [[Assault on Kamino]] to board and disable the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']]. Boarding in small pods, the Saber Guards easily overtook the hangar and many other vital areas of the ship such as the engine room, the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], and numerous gun emplacements. Despite overcoming the rebel defenders with relative ease, the Saber Guards proved to be utterly ineffective against [[Subject 1138|Starkiller]], a clone of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] late [[Galen Marek|secret apprentice]]. The Saber Guards were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the clone as he systematically exterminated the Imperial presence aboard the ''Salvation''.<ref name="TFU2vg" />

When the Rebel Alliance launched a planetary assault on Kamino and stormed Timira City, the Saber Guards assisted the Imperial garrison in putting up a fierce resistance to protect the planet's cloning facilities. After Starkiller returned to Timira City in search of Vader and [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]], numerous Saber Guards attempted to halt his advance. However, this proved unsuccessful, and most of them were eliminated. The battle was eventually won by the Alliance and the remaining Saber Guards on Kamino likely perished with the rest of the planet's garrison.<ref name="TFU2vg" />

==Powers and abilities==
Although Saber Guards were much less skilled in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] than the Imperial Sith Acolyte, they were able to erect a [[Force barrier/Legends|Force barrier]] around themselves to shield against Force attacks, and were also capable of using Saber Throw. They were known to utilize two lightsabers in combat much like [[Galen Marek]]'s clone. They were equipped with armor which was resistant to lightsabers. But despite their powerful Force barriers, they were notably vulnerable to the [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force repulse|Force repulse]] attack. In contrast with their counterparts, they were not capable of resisting a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]], which if employed, often led to disastrous results for the Imperial teams that had been assigned to assist them. Saber Guards could resist lightsaber attacks, Force powers and enhanced grapples, so the only way to make them vulnerable was by performing a Saber grapple on them.<ref name="TFU2vg" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Saber Guards, and by extension the [[Imperial Sith Acolyte]]s' vocal clips resembled those of the failed Galen Marek clones encountered on [[Timira City]] later in the game. Whether this was reused assets or an implication that both parties were composed of repurposed Galen Marek clones to compensate for failing to replicate the deceased secret apprentice is unclear.
